audience: developers and content teams who store images and files in Uploadcare

useCases.title: Browse your latest uploaded files
useCases.text: The AI lists files in the project, and opens one to read its name, size, type, whether it is an image, tags and metadata.

useCases.title: Check project details and file groups
useCases.text: The AI reads the project name, public key, collaborators and autostore setting, and lists file groups.

useCases.title: Upload a file from a URL, or keep a file stored
useCases.text: The AI uploads a file from a public URL into the project. It can also mark an existing file, by its UUID, as stored so it is kept.

useCases.title: Delete files you no longer need
useCases.text: The AI finds a file and deletes it from the project for good. Confirm the file first.

useCases.title: Review and add webhooks
useCases.text: The AI lists the webhook subscriptions of the project and can create a new one that posts to a target URL when an event fires.
